719:t_013:5.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Like hell we need to tell you!」

719:t_013:6.en:
$$アサキム$$
「...I intended to take your $$スフィア$$s later, but if you interfere with me, I have no choice...」

719:t_014:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「As I am now, I can even do this.」

719:t_015:0.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「That bastard! He's brought the $$アンチスパイラル$$'s forces under his control!」

719:t_015:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「So he wasn't just talking when he said he'd become stronger!」

719:t_016:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You, too, need to feel firsthand the meaning of $$シュロウガ$$'s existence.」

719:t_016:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「So fighting the $$御使い$$s alongside us isn't an option for you.」

719:t_016:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You can't know that unless we try!」

719:t_016:5.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「You can't know that unless we try!」

719:t_016:6.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「You can't know that unless we try!」

719:t_016:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「Are you looking down on us, $$アサキム$$?」

719:t_016:9.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Very well! I'll teach you the fact that you can never defeat them!」

719:t_017:0.en:
$$シン$$
「How's that, $$アサキム$$?! We win!」

719:t_017:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「All that big talk, and that's all you've got?!」

719:t_019:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「As you can see, as my power grew, the curses engraved on them grew stronger, too.」

719:t_019:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「And they use this curse as their own power.」

719:t_019:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「While we're at it, you should learn more about them.」

719:t_019:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I'll allow you to meet $$哀しみのサクリファイ$$.」

719:t_020:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「In a sense, we were completely defeated...」

719:t_020:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Yes... Even if we defeat him, it doesn't become a victory...」

719:t_020:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「What's more, he wasn't attacking seriously, either. He only wanted to show us that...」

719:t_020:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「An enemy we can't defeat even if we shoot him down... And we still haven't seen the full extent of his power...」

719:t_020:6.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「If the $$御使い$$s have even greater power than he does...」

719:t_020:8.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「If they were just strong, we could find a way to fight, but if they're immortal...」

719:t_020:11.en:
$$ランド$$
「Well... Things will work out somehow.」

719:t_020:14.en:
$$ランド$$
「If we can't defeat them, there are other ways, like sealing them in a $$ＺＯＮＥ$$.」

719:t_020:15.en:
$$セツコ$$
「That's why we mustn't lose hope.」

719:t_020:16.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's how it is, Chief, $$ＡＧ$$. We'll stop $$アサキム$$ and the $$御使い$$s, but I'm counting on you to handle what comes afterward.」

719:t_020:18.en:
$$トライア$$
「First, let's think about making the most of the chance $$アサキム$$ gave us.」

719:t_020:19.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$$哀しみのサクリファイ$$... So that's her name...」

719:t_020:20.en:
$$レド$$
「But what do we do? It seems our attacks can't even scratch that crystal-like asteroid.」

719:t_020:21.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「So it's something like the $$スヴェル$$.」

719:t_021:1.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「Is the $$悲しみの乙女$$'s $$スフィア$$ reacting...?!」

719:t_021:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...Even if we can't destroy it, we might be able to synchronize our consciousness and get past that wall.」

719:t_022:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「So that is... $$哀しみのサクリファイ$$...」

719:t_023:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「What the $$アンチスパイラル$$ left wasn't fighting strength for the $$御使い$$s to use! It was a wish for us to protect this universe!」

719:t_023:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「Let's do this! To fulfill that wish, we'll crush all its forces here!」

719:t_024:0.en:
$$マオ$$
「I confirm the $$エル・ミレニウム$$ has been shot down!」

719:t_024:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「We're doing better than I expected!」

719:t_024:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「Of course. To me, her $$真化融合$$ is merely an imitation.」

719:t_024:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's simple. She is merely dominating the machine, rather than becoming one with it.」

719:t_024:5.en:
$$レド$$
「Exactly. Just as domination is different from coexistence.」

719:t_024:6.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「My analysis confirms an overall improvement in capability, but I judge it inferior to the enhancement of allied units through $$真化融合$$.」

719:t_024:7.en:
$$レド$$
「There's no need to fear an imitation! Let's finish this quickly!」

719:t_100:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I feel the will of that $$御使い$$ called $$テンプティ$$ coming from the crystal monster...!」

719:t_100:2.en:
$n
「That's what makes $$テンプティ$$ frightening...! If she's having fun, she won't hesitate in the slightest to take someone's life!」

719:t_101:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Understand that none of your common sense will apply to the battles from here on.」

719:t_101:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You would be happier if I hunted you down here!」

719:t_101:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I have no intention of letting anyone decide my happiness! Especially you!」

719:t_102:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「Enough looking down on us, $$アサキム$$!」

719:t_102:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「That is not my intention. I am grateful to you.」

719:t_102:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「For nurturing the $$スフィア$$s for me up to this day!」

719:t_102:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's exactly what I mean by looking down on us! I'll let you have it, $$アサキム$$!」

719:t_103:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Quit being so coy, $$アサキム$$. Hurry up and use your full strength.」

719:t_103:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I can't fool your eyes, $$クロウ$$.」
